gap: No result ChatGPT got states that the J-Tech JTECH-14EX60-AE, its 'Best overall 1×4' card at $302.49, is listed as unavailable on J-Tech's own store on 2026-11-10. J-Tech's other 4K60 1×4 extender splitter, the JTECH-14EX50 at $345.08, is also unavailable. The only J-Tech 4K60 extender splitters listed as available are the 1×8 JTECH-18EX50 at $559.07 and the 1×8 JTECH-18EX60-AE at $639.99.
standout_why: I compared against the two cited rival pages: OREI's support articles for the UHD12-EX115-K and the UHD14-EXB400-K. I also checked the other OREI support articles in the results. They give full specs (distance at each resolution, PoC, EDID, IR, power draw) but no price and no stock status, and none of them covers J-Tech. So the price and stock of ChatGPT's 'Best overall 1×4' pick appears in no result ChatGPT got. ChatGPT's answer shows $302.49 with no sign that the maker's store lists it as unavailable.
decides: This weakens ChatGPT's 1×4 pick. A shopper who wants four TVs at 4K60 from J-Tech direct can't buy either 1×4 model today. The cheapest J-Tech 4K60 extender splitter listed as available is the 1×8 JTECH-18EX50 at $559.07, and its 4K60 reach is only 114 ft. That leaves OREI's 1×4 models as the practical 1×4 choices, but I couldn't confirm OREI prices today because OREI's store, Best Buy and Walmart all blocked me. For two TVs, the OREI UHD12-EX115-K stays the pick on specs (4K60 4:4:4 to 115 ft, receivers powered over the Cat cable). Its price is unconfirmed today.
